property_summary: After initialization, a second call to initialize (which should revert in the reference but succeeds in the buggy version) leaves initialized = false in the buggy version while the reference reverts, so availableForFlashLoan does not change it; the difference is observed via try/catch on the second initialize call.
change_summary: Delete the `if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();` guard so initialize can be called multiple times, overwriting the state and keeping `initialized` false on the second call.
